# Rust

Learn Rust through **16 short, working chapters** rather than one oversized example.

[**Open the Rust Core Concepts learning path**](rust/index.qmd).

Start with [Ownership](rust/01-ownership.qmd), [Borrowing](rust/02-borrowing.qmd) and [Lifetimes](rust/03-lifetimes.qmd), then explore [Macros](rust/12-declarative-macros.qmd) and [Custom Procedural Attributes](rust/13-attributes-and-proc-macros.qmd).

Each chapter explains **one central idea**, includes a minimal runnable program, and identifies an important counterexample. The examples target Rust stable 1.100.0 and Rust 2024 Edition.
